name: production_confirmation
title: Production confirmations
description: Production confirmations. Preserve confirmation/counter identity and reversal relationships; do not delete reversals and assume the remaining history is net yield. Target order/operation mapping and posting periods must be approved. Reposting confirmations can trigger backflush, goods movements, activity allocations and accounting; confirmation history is reference-only unless a supported process migration explicitly authorizes those effects.
tested_release: none (draft, ECC 6.0 on NetWeaver 7.40 SP08 assumed)
